description: Fix 2 static HTML issues: (1) payment.html missing payment-success detection banner, (2) certificate-locked.html inline <script> ReferenceError because SERVER_AMOUNT/PLAN_AMOUNTS are referenced before they are defined. Independent of FEAT-002 at the file level, but logically depends on FEAT-002's /payment/callback route existing.
steps: FIX A (static/payment.html — add success banner): At the very top of the existing <script> block (before 'const API = ...'), insert an IIFE that checks URLSearchParams for payment=success or status=success. If found, creates a fixed-position green banner div and prepends it to document.body. Banner shows: '✅ Payment received! Your account will be updated automatically.' plus the reference code if present (from ?ref= or ?reference= or ?trxref=) and a link 'Go to MyPy Tutor →' pointing to https://mypytutor.com.ng

FIX B (static/certificate-locked.html — fix inline script ReferenceError): Remove the inline <script> block that is inside the Paystack panel <div> (it reads: '(function(){ var a = SERVER_AMOUNT || PLAN_AMOUNTS[SERVER_PLAN] || 0; if(a) document.getElementById("ps-label")...'). This block runs before the main <script> defines SERVER_AMOUNT/PLAN_AMOUNTS, causing ReferenceError. Instead, add the same IIFE at the very END of the main <script> block (just before </script>), after all variable and function declarations. The IIFE sets the ps-label button text to the correct price.
Commit: 'fix: payment.html success banner + certificate-locked.html ReferenceError'
acceptance_criteria: Opening http://localhost:8000/payment?payment=success&ref=TEST123 in a browser shows a green banner at the top with 'Payment received!' and 'TEST123'

Opening http://localhost:8000/certificate/basic (for a learner with no tier — server returns 402 with certificate-locked.html) shows the correct price on the Pay Now button (e.g. '🚀 Pay ₦30,000 — Unlock Certificate') with no browser console ReferenceError
All existing Paystack and bank-transfer functionality in payment.html still works (startPaystack(), submitProof(), applyCoupon() functions are unchanged)
verification: curl -s 'http://localhost:8000/payment?payment=success&ref=ABC' | grep -o 'Payment received' → prints 'Payment received' (the banner HTML is in the page source... wait, it's JS not SSR — verify in browser instead)
In browser: open http://localhost:8000/payment?payment=success → green banner visible
In browser: open http://localhost:8000/certificate/basic (unauthenticated) → button shows price, no console ReferenceError

python -c "content=open('static/certificate-locked.html').read(); print('inline_script_gone' if 'SERVER_AMOUNT || PLAN_AMOUNTS' not in content.split('</script>')[0].split('<script>')[1] else 'STILL_BROKEN')"
findings: FIX A applied: detectPaymentSuccess IIFE inserted at top of <script> block in static/payment.html (before 'const API = ...'). Checks ?payment=success or ?status=success, creates fixed-position green banner with ref param and link to mypytutor.com.ng. FIX B applied: removed inline <script> from inside id=panel-paystack div in static/certificate-locked.html (was causing ReferenceError because SERVER_AMOUNT/PLAN_AMOUNTS run before main script). Equivalent IIFE added at end of main <script> block, after all variable declarations, so it executes after SERVER_AMOUNT is defined. INTEGRATION VERIFIED (Iteration 1): banner_ok confirmed in payment.html, ref_error_fixed confirmed in certificate-locked.html — panel-paystack div contains no inline <script>, and the IIFE at lines 522-527 runs after SERVER_AMOUNT is defined at line 302.
